text:
rachael: FYI planning to flip v2 structured-response (new `.choices[].metadata`) on for API routes next maintenance window. Primary risk: client-side JSON parsing that assumes old flat shape. Need rollout/playbook + CS comms.

ben: Good catch. Suggest schema-guard gate: if tenant sees schema_mismatch_rate > 0.8% in a 15m window, auto-pin them back to v1. Also surface sample failing payloads to #eng-support.

kai: For rollout steps I'm proposing quick canaries: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m observation per step and schema_mismatch as primary gate.

deploy-bot: Plan template created: v2-structured-2026-04-12T02:00Z. Run `/deploybot preflight v2-structured --env=prod` before starting. Canary-bot integration available for automated gate checks.

devops-bot: NOTE: infra change required: request-transform proxy needs header passthrough fix (PR #4227). Will link when merged. Rollout blocked until merged.

rachael: CS ask: provide a one-click tenant toggle in the pin dashboard and a short template message for CS to send if a tenant is pinned.

cs-team: we'll need the template + list of affected endpoints. Also request a 72h optional grace period for enterprise customers who opt out.

ben: Rollback/pausing rules propose:
- schema_mismatch_pct >= 0.8% in 15m -> pause and pin affected tenants
- error_rate_delta >= 0.7% -> pause global ramp
- p50 latency increase >= 120ms -> slow ramp to next step (do not pause automatically)

kai: Automation snippets:
```
/rollout step v2_structured set 10%
/rollout pause v2_structured
/rollout set v2_structured 0% --force --reason="schema_mismatch"
```

rachael: Release notes checklist (short):
- breaking note about `.choices[].metadata` field added
- SDK migration code snippet (JS/Python) to handle missing field
- CS template for pin + migration help
- compat matrix (sdk versions vs server behavior)

deploy-bot: Preflight started on staging at 2026-04-10T20:03Z. Staging report: schema_mismatch ~0.02% over 2h. Recommend prod dry-run.

kai: I'll wire canary-bot thresholds: schema_mismatch=0.8, error_delta=0.7, p50_latency_ms=120. Canary-bot will post summary after each 15m window.

devops-bot: PR #4227 merged at 2026-04-11T01:10Z. Remember to bump proxy config in rollout service.

rachael: Final asks before schedule: CS toggle ready, release notes draft in #docs-review, deploy preflight green, ops oncall confirmed. If all green I'll schedule for 2026-04-12T02:00Z UTC.

canary-bot: Scheduled dry-run: v2-structured-dryrun-prod at 2026-04-11T22:00Z. Will report to this thread.

ben: One more: add debug sampling header for pinned tenants so we can capture failing responses: `X-RW-Debug: schema-sample`

rachael: Great idea. Add to runbook and CS template.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v2-structured-2026-04-12T02:00Z. Will post step progress and gate evaluations every 15m. Good luck! :rocket:
